units.source_text: [\[3\]](#part1333.html#w3) 为对外关系而设置在筑前（九州的一国）的行政机构称为太宰府，

en.t: [3] The administrative office established in Chikuzen, one of the provinces of Kyushu, for handling foreign relations was called the Dazaifu,

units.source_text: 其长官称帅，次官称大弍、少弍。

en.t: its chief official was called the Sochi, and the deputy officials were called the Daini and Shoni.

units.source_text: 这里是乳母的丈夫的官职名称。

en.t: Here, this is the title of the office held by the wet nurse's husband.
